statement: Consider a sequence of the preceding data in dimensions at most n0. Suppose that the common actual slices satisfy q(fj) = 0 identically, that w is a centred point of the slice with the stipulated normal finitely generated klt graded algebra, and that the cones satisfy the following balance condition with one constant C along the sequence: q0 (s) ≤ Cw0 (s) 0 ̸= s ∈ R̆ fine-homogeneous, q0 common, q0 (h̄) = w(h) = 1. (F.12) After passage to a subsequence, the w can be replaced by w′ with all these properties, with a new fixed balance constant, and with w′ (f) = (1 + o(1))w(f) (0 ̸= f ∈ OS,x), (F.13) uniformly in f in the normalization w′(h) = w(h) = 1. On the angular model Vu of the new cone, the notation of Section D then satisfies T(Γ) ≤ (1 + ηi)D(T), ηi −→ 0, (F.14) for every effective Q-divisor Γ ∼Q D and every primitive divisorial T such that a(T) = 0 and T( ¯ fj) ≥ 0 for all j. This is condition (C-α) of Section C. The initial symbols here refer to w′. The balance hypothesis holds when w is the exact minimizer on the common slice for the height q(h).
